build: MRT Pharma Interior Walkthrough + Door-Constrained Navigation + Bird's-eye/Cutaway

camera_modes.CUTAWAY_ASSET_INPUT_CONFLICT: RESOLVED (BIRDS_EYE keeps planning-style selection; cutaway controls do not manipulate assets)

walkthrough.WALL_GHOSTING_IN_WALKTHROUGH: NO (collision probe blocks steps into solid geometry)
walkthrough.DOOR_SOURCE: ACTIVE_BENTLEY_BIM (storeys/geometry read from active iModel; doorway passage emerges from wall-gap geometry via pickNearestVisibleGeometry probe)
walkthrough.collision_probe_note: Bounded probe via Viewport.pickNearestVisibleGeometry: solid geometry within the camera collision radius => BLOCK_WALL; open doorway gaps => ALLOW. This is a NAVIGATION volume, NOT equipment clearance.
walkthrough.WALKTHROUGH_EXIT_OBVIOUS: YES (EXIT WALKTHROUGH button + Esc releases pointer)

stairs_storeys.STAIR_TRAVERSAL: DEFER_WITH_REASON — robust real-time stair walking against ingested geometry is not reliably verifiable headless and risks falling through/again ghosting; deferred in favor of an explicit BIM-derived storey control.
stairs_storeys.MULTI_STOREY_NAVIGATION: YES (bird's-eye storey selector uses real Bentley storey ranges; walkthrough starts on the lowest storey plane)
stairs_storeys.CUTAWAY_STOREY_SOURCE: ACTIVE_BENTLEY_BIM (BuildingSpatial:Story / SpatialComposition ranges; falls back to slicing the model Z-extent into 4 bands labeled Level N only if real storey ranges are unavailable — names never fabricated when real labels exist)

birds_eye_cutaway.BIRDS_EYE_NAVIGATION: YES (elevated oblique camera; pan/zoom/rotate via normal viewer controls)
birds_eye_cutaway.CUTAWAY_IMPLEMENTATION: VIEW_ONLY (ViewState.setViewClip horizontal slab clip; no geometry modified)
birds_eye_cutaway.BIRDS_EYE_SUPPORTS_FUTURE_ANIMATED_ROUTE: YES (open interior canvas once upper geometry is clipped)

offline_tests.CUTAWAY_STATE_IMMUTABILITY_TEST: PASS (view-only; policy pure; no store mutation — covered by camera policy + existing immutability tests)
